reproduction_target: Computational LGR-detection pipeline of the eLaRodON tool: benchmarking eLaRodON against NanoSV/Sniffles2/NanoVar/SVIM on public Oxford Nanopore data (38 M. tuberculosis SRA genomes + human NA12878), with Flye de novo assemblies + Mauve alignments generating gold-standard LGR sets, minimap2 read alignment (hg19/hg38 + lambda-phage-augmented reference), and custom Python BED generation from GenBank annotations. Wet-lab orthogonal validation (targeted NGS + Sanger on private tumor DNA) is out of computational scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from biorxiv JATS Methods prose (fetched via curl; WebFetch was 403). eLaRodON is the authors' own tool with a live GitHub repo (github.com/aakechin/eLaRodON) shipping a pip package + requirements.txt pinning 5 Python deps (biopython==1.84, pandas==2.2.2, pysam==0.22.1, toml==0.10.2, tqdm==4.66.5) -> exact_pins_partial (Python-only; external tools minimap2/samtools/vcfanno installed via unpinned 'conda install -c bioconda', no lockfile/container). README prose read only (no workflow source line-reading at stage1). Wet-lab validation steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Flye v2.9.5-b1801 de novo assembly of M. tuberculosis ONT reads (gold-standard reference generation)
Mauve whole-genome alignment of de novo assemblies to build gold-standard LGR sets - no version
minimap2 read alignment to human reference hg19 (tool comparison) and hg38+lambda-augmented reference; also junction-fragment re-mapping - no version, no params
eLaRodON LGR detection (the authors' tool) on ONT BAMs from public M. tuberculosis + NA12878 data; code on GitHub, pip-installable, requirements.txt pins Python deps
Custom Python scripts to identify mobile elements/repeats from GenBank files and generate BED files - no version, availability/pointer not stated in prose
SVABA-derived gold-standard human (hg19) SV set - pre-existing external truth set, not run by the authors

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 6/10 computational steps: the version-pinned tools eLaRodON (own repo + pinned Python deps), Flye 2.9.5-b1801, Sniffles2 2.6.1, NanoVar 1.8.3, SVIM 2.0.0, NanoSV 1.2.4. 3/10 steps cap at NI due to unpinned versions (Mauve, minimap2, custom BED Python scripts). 1/10 (SVABA gold-standard set) is X (external precomputed truth set, not executed by authors). R★ not assignable at stage1; even under stage2 no step exceeds RI because capture is exact_pins_partial (Python-only pins; external bioconda tools unpinned; no lockfile/container claimed).
